cs.t: 1. Beats by Dre - Beats Studio Pro Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones are my #1 favourite thing. I hate residual background noise and I’m quite obsessed with music just generally so these just bring me a lot of happiness. 2. Spotify 2nd - because there is so much to listen to ranging from music, to podcasts about anything, to rainstorms and pink noise. 3. It’s actually an activity, but swimming is a top favourite thing to do at the moment because I can swim for ages and still feel completely fine, but also I’ve noticed since I’ve been swimming my breathing (when not in water) feels different in a good way, perhaps more efficient. 4. My MacBook. It’s the only laptop I’ve ever had that lasted more than 2 years. It’s still going strong and is perfect for what I use it for (mainly research and writing). 5. My cat Timmy - because he’s just really cuddly and he meows a lot and I just think he’s really cute, even though I’m not really a cat person, I just really like that one particular cat a lot.
